critical_code_review_comments: _rehab_runner_html falls back to REHAB_RUNNER_CONFIG['ex_maintenance'] for unknown ids — robust, never 500s. ✓

REHAB_RUNNER_HTML_TEMPLATE is large (~400 lines inside server.py); future iterations may want to split runner templates into separate files served via Jinja or static HTML to keep server.py < 700 lines (currently >1700 lines — violates code-review file-size guideline).

feedback_rules use string conditions evaluated client-side (e.g. 'trunk_lean_deg > 18'). Safe because evaluated on per-rep metrics object, but consider parsing instead of eval'ing if ever extended.

exercise.tsx correctly forwards exercise_id query param; uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (no hardcoded URL). ✓
